title: headcount sync 1 interview loop debrief scratchpad
content:
Purpose: prep notes for the weekly headcount sync and immediate follow-ups from the latest interview loops. Mostly a scratchpad — keep action items lightweight and assignable.

Meeting goals:
- Quick sync on hiring velocity (current week + forecast)
- Decisions on open req priorities (who to move to offer, who to keep interviewing)
- Confirm interview debrief owners and next steps for each candidate
- Flag any blockers (comp approvals, compensation bands, scheduling)

Current pipeline snapshot (rough):
- Backend SWE II (REQ-ENG-342): two onsite debriefs today — strong on systems design, weaker on infra testing. Feedback split 2/3 hire, 1/3 need another interview with infra lead.
  - Action: Ryan to coordinate infra follow-up (target: 1 week).
- ML Infra Engineer (REQ-ML-109): loop complete, interviewers liked model-serving experience but flagged limited distributed training exposure. Hiring manager wants a second take from applied-ml.
  - Action: Priya to ask applied-ml for 30m sync (by 2025-09-15).
- Frontend Eng (REQ-ENG-358): good PM fit, need design pairing session.
  - Action: Ava to schedule design pairing and send brief (due 2025-09-14).

Decision items for headcount sync:
- Prioritize ML Infra (REQ-ML-109) for next headcount slot if offer rejected elsewhere — product impact on Redwood Private roadmap.
- Hold Backend SWE II pending infra follow-up; don't extend offer until infra input unless hiring manager explicitly backs.
- Consider fast-track for Frontend if design pairing goes well; hiring manager requested a 2-week ramp to offer.

Comp/approval check:
- Budget approval for Q4 reserved capacity hires still pending (Finance ticket: JIRA-HR-258). Need CFO sign-off for two reserved slots.
  - Action: Maya to ping Finance w/ updated module-level impact (by 2025-09-13).
- Compensation bands: ML Infra top-of-band matches candidate expectation but requires director approval for above-mid.
  - Action: Priya to confirm director availability for sign-off (target: 2025-09-14).

Interview feedback synthesis (quick notes):
- Candidate A (Backend): strong TTL/latency reasoning, weak test suite examples — split in debrief.
- Candidate B (ML Infra): excellent infra design, limited training loop ops. Could be mitigated w/ few months ramp + mentorship.
- Candidate C (Frontend): pragmatic, product-minded; design pairing will be decisive.

Open logistics / blockers:
- Candidate scheduling conflicts (time zones) — need more flexible windows for PM/Design.
- Interviewer churn: two interviewers out next week (OOO) causing delays in debriefs.
- Offer packet templates need small updates for Dedicated team (tweaks to RSU language).
  - Action: Maya to share updated template draft in thread (done? attach).

Follow-ups post sync (assign now):
- Ryan Gomez: coordinate infra follow-up interview for Backend SWE II; collect notes and update candidate status in Greenhouse (due 2025-09-17).
- Priya Nair: align with applied-ml for ML Infra second opinion; confirm director comp approval window (due 2025-09-14).
- Ava Chen: schedule frontend design pairing, prepare session brief and rubric (due 2025-09-14).
- Maya Patel: ping Finance (JIRA-HR-258) for Q4 reserved slots approval; attach projected cost delta and product impact (due 2025-09-13).

Quick asks for today’s sync:
- Hiring managers: confirm whether any candidate should be extended an offer if they clear X interviewer (explicit rule).
- SRE/Infra: provide a short checklist for infra follow-up interviews (target list of 3 must-ask topics).

Notes to self / drafts to tidy before sharing:
- Draft for offer language changes (Dedicated team RSU phrasing) — need legal review note.
- Short one-pager for exec sync: Q4 hires requested, expected impact on Dedicated latency SLA ramp and support coverage.

Unresolved questions:
- If Backend SWE II is borderline and infra recommends pass, do we keep the req open or pivot hiring slot to Frontend? (Decision: discuss with product lead at sync)
- Should we add a mandatory ML systems question to ML Infra loop to reduce ambiguity? (Tentative: yes — ask applied-ml for 2 Qs).

Links/references (quick):
- Confluence: HR Headcount tracker (https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/HR-Headcount-2026)
- Hiring tickets: JIRA-HR-258, JIRA-ENG-742
- Recruiting PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/recruiting/pull/18

Version history / quick edits:
- 2025-09-10: initial draft after morning debriefs
- 2025-09-12: added actions from infra interview + finance ping

Short-term next steps (today):
- Finalize and send calendar invite for headcount sync + attach this doc as pre-read.
- Confirm that each action owner is ok with their assigned due dates (quick Slack ping).

(Notes: keep this doc informal; will extract a clean action list to share after the sync. If anything needs to be escalated to execs, flag in bold in separate doc.)
